page.layout: One printed title page, centred. Top: the title in large capitals, in four or five lines, in the upper left. Below it, a line or two of smaller type. Lower centre: a printer's device (engraving), faint. At the foot: a few small lines of imprint, faint. Show-through from the reverse appears at the top right and right edge. The library stamp is not transcribed.
page.notes: The page is very faded. Only the first four title lines are legible, and even these are uncertain: "IN LIBRVM", "SALOMONIS QVI", "INSCRIBITVR ECCLESIASTES" and "COMMENTARIVS" are read from faint traces and may be wrong. The lines below them and the imprint at the foot are not legible. The central engraving (a printer's device) is faint and not transcribed. The library stamp "BIBLIOTHEQUE PUBLIQUE DE GENEVE" with a shelf number is excluded. Mirrored text at the top right and right edge is show-through and is excluded.
